name: Rogowski TI Gerber Coil Generator
description: Two independent windings recreated from TI TIDA010971E2.0 copper and NC drill geometry.
description_full: KiCad 10 reference-accurate 32-position PCB Rogowski coil. Exact 4 alternating via rings (64 vias) + two breakout vias, GTL/GBL D132 trace centre-lines. Two separate electrical nets. Four radii, drill size, track width, rotation and center are configurable. For non-32 positions (12 to 96 multiples of 4), a trace-template-derived parametric pattern is generated without left breakout to prevent shorts. See README for limitations.
